EXH1_KO only: IL-15 raised 5 to 15 ng/mL (adjustment A2)

title: Rocking-bag CAR-T expansion to day 10, unedited vs EXH1 knockout (iteration 2)
label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: built from a synthetic source. Not a validated protocol and not clinical or manufacturing guidance.

insights.statement: The source process activates for 48 h, transduces on day 2 and harvests on day 10, which matches the day-10 question directly.
insights.relevance: Fixes the schedule and the harvest day.

insights.statement: Replacing IL-2 with IL-7 plus IL-15 raised total expansion 1.7-fold in the same bag format.
insights.relevance: Addresses a shortfall that is quantity-limited rather than identity-limited.

insights.statement: EXH1-knockout T cells needed a 24 h activation and IL-15 at 15 ng/mL to match unedited cells.
insights.relevance: Gives the knockout arm its own activation length and IL-15 dose.

genotype_arms.modification: CRISPR-Cas9 frameshift (placeholder gene name for this synthetic fixture)
genotype_arms.description: Isogenic knockout of a placeholder exhaustion-associated gene

genotype_effects.affected_quantity: activation length and IL-15 dose required to reach control-level output
genotype_effects.mechanism: With a 24 h activation and IL-15 at 15 ng/mL the knockout is reported to match unedited cells (c13, c14), so no difference in output is predicted.

arm_adjustments.rationale: EXH1-knockout cells require a 24 h activation rather than 48 h (claim c13), so the activation reagent is washed out a day earlier in this arm only.
EXH1-knockout cells require IL-15 at 15 ng/mL (claim c14). The control stays at 5 ng/mL.

open_questions: The source does not report a CAR+ fraction, so no expected transduction efficiency is carried into this protocol.
Feeding is described only as a half-volume addition; the trigger density is not reported.
The knockout's adjustments rest on a single synthetic source; a replicated run is needed before the effect size is anything but directional.
risks: One replicate per arm makes every genotype comparison directional only.
Vector lot and donor variability are not represented in a single run.
limitations: Built from a synthetic source for software testing.
A reported setting is not an optimised or validated setting.
